## Document Location
Link or file path (e.g., `README.md`, `docs/api/API_REFERENCE.md`, `docs/deployment/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md`):

## Issue Description
Describe what is inaccurate, outdated, missing, or confusing.

## Suggested Improvement
Provide the proposed wording, example command, or correction.

## Verification Context
If reporting a discrepancy between documentation and code, reference the relevant source file or endpoint path.
